fourIssueResolution.title: Git-state reporting
fourIssueResolution.resolution: Git operations by this review (index edits, staging, commits, reset, checkout, stash): NONE. Working-tree files changed during the review: the evidence-documentation corrections listed in repositoryState.after. Pre-existing user work preserved. A clean working tree never existed. The index staging state nevertheless changed externally during the review window (several files observed staged by review end); that external change is reported as-is and was not performed by this review.

fourIssueResolution.title: Campaign artifacts in evidence package
fourIssueResolution.resolution: The original campaign log and summary JSON were located in the session-state files directory, hash-verified, and copied verbatim into .obsidian-vault/specs/. Both package copies are byte-identical to the originals (SHA-256 recorded above).

fourIssueResolution.title: Disposal sequence
fourIssueResolution.resolution: See disposalSequence: the child runner deferred row-level cleanup; the parent orchestrator executed docker compose down scoped to the unique project and recorded disposed:true and disposalVerified:true in the summary JSON at disposal time. Current absence of salesgst containers is corroboration only.

fourIssueResolution.title: Sales vs Purchase scope
fourIssueResolution.resolution: See scopeClassification: the campaign's primary acceptance objective is Sales GST application acceptance; purchase scenarios are integration/guard coverage whose PASS applies only to the exact exercised assertions and does not establish Purchase GST modernization, ITC lifecycle, freight/discount allocation, or statutory rounding.

implementationReview.conclusion: Changes are surgical and in-scope for Sales GST: fixture ownership via memberships (fail-closed), single CJS auth-adapter module instance, query helper, governance-consistent fixtures, DISPOSABLE_TARGET_DISPOSAL cleanup mode, immutable-history row-deletion guard, and the campaign orchestrator. No assertion was weakened, no scenario was skipped (GST_E2E_ONLY was not set), and no mock database was used: scenarios run against the live disposable database through the restricted runtime role.
implementationReview.regressionsOutsideSalesGst: None observed; the full 231-test suite passes.

disposalSequence.requested: The child acceptance runner did not request deletion. It emitted FIXTURE-DISPOSAL=DATABASE_LEVEL_DEFERRED and IMMUTABLE-HISTORY=PRESERVED_NOT_DELETED, skipping its own row-level cleanup.
disposalSequence.deferred: The runner deferred row-level fixture cleanup to database-level disposal owned by the parent orchestrator.
disposalSequence.executed: VERIFIED PASS - the orchestrator ran docker compose down with the campaign-unique project, env file, and --profile financial-e2e; the summary JSON records disposed:true only when that command exited 0.
disposalSequence.verified: VERIFIED PASS - the orchestrator checked docker ps -a --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=<unique-project> returned no containers and recorded disposalVerified:true in the summary JSON at disposal time.
disposalSequence.corroboration: Current docker ps -a shows no salesgst containers; treated as corroboration, not the sole basis.
disposalSequence.consoleEvidenceLimitation: The orchestrator's console lines (TARGET_DISPOSAL=VERIFIED, SALES-GST-CAMPAIGN=COMPLETE) exist only in the session tool transcript; the persisted machine-readable disposal evidence is the summary JSON disposed/verification fields.
